scope: Publisher contention development fix. Runtime inspection was read-only. Regression qualification uses isolated databases, SQL-style HTTP fixtures and the shipped browser code; no live commands or provider calls were submitted.

reproduced_failure.scenario: Nine concurrent visible targets lazily initialize their source publisher before the dynamic import resolves.
reproduced_failure.mock_limitation: Earlier HTTP fixtures accepted every publisher claimant and did not enforce one document owner.
reproduced_failure.before_log_assertion: one page must not compete with itself for the document lease: 9 !== 1

fix.shared_initialization: Assign a shared promise synchronously before awaiting the module; all captures share its single identity, serialization tail and publication sequence.
fix.server_lease_metadata: A publisher-conflict response includes the current generation, lease_until and remaining retry_after_ms. The rejected claim changes no publisher row.
fix.contention: Cache one lease conflict per document and suppress additional claims from other targets or manual retry controls until expiry; reset on navigation.
fix.generation_recovery: Learn the observed generation while blocked. After expiry, retry its CAS. An already expired generation can be learned and claimed immediately.
fix.pending_batch: Treat only structured publisher lease conflicts as temporary preparation failures. Retain the batch intent and display lease waiting, while other source conflicts retain their rejection semantics.
fix.fencing: Live ownership checks and generation/sequence CAS are unchanged. Lost ownership clears recent receipts/archive reuse. Both publication response-loss attempts honor lease conflict fencing.
fix.boundary: All publication and command admission remains through SQL API endpoints. No direct worker, workspace or editor callback access was introduced.

process_and_handoff_tests.skip_reason: Explicit native confined Lean qualification; no Lean execution changed.

validation.visual_check: Reviewed the lease-waiting surface at narrow pane width; text and controls fit the existing pane.
validation.release_scope: No new production image or rollback qualification is claimed.
